title: Configure SOCFortress CoPilot
description: Configure SOCFortress CoPilot. Settings left out keep their current value.

lets_encrypt.title: Let's Encrypt certificate
lets_encrypt.description: Request a valid Let's Encrypt certificate.

http2https.title: HTTP to HTTPS redirection
http2https.description: Redirect all the HTTP requests to HTTPS

access_token_expire_minutes.description: Lifetime of a login session, in minutes (ACCESS_TOKEN_EXPIRE_MINUTES)

audit_log_retention_days.description: Days the audit log is kept, 0 keeps it forever (AUDIT_LOG_RETENTION_DAYS)

default_alert_severity.description: Severity of the alerts whose source gives none (DEFAULT_ALERT_SEVERITY)

announcements_enabled.description: Show the SOCFortress news feed, fetched from GitHub (ANNOUNCEMENTS_ENABLED)

talon_release_check_enabled.description: Check ghcr.io for new Talon releases (TALON_RELEASE_CHECK_ENABLED)

mail_from.description: Sender of the CoPilot e-mails, sent through the NS8 smarthost (SMTP_FROM). Empty: the smarthost user name, else noreply@<host>.
